# Longbridge Fundamentals

⚠️ **Trading warning / Avertissement trading** : informational only, not investment advice. A low multiple can mark a bargain or a business in decline, and statements alone never settle that question. Curated by Skill Harbor: the fundamentals skill of the Longbridge platform, published by the broker itself. Through the Longbridge CLI it covers the income statement, balance sheet and cash flow statement, detailed statements with period selection, revenue breakdown by business segment, dividend history, valuation multiples (PE, PB, PS, dividend yield) with peer comparison, industry valuation comparison and distribution, a valuation percentile rank inside the industry, a multi-stock comparison matrix (PE, PB, ROE, revenue growth), company and executive profiles, corporate actions, subsidiary and parent relationships, and Hong Kong operating reviews. On top of the data sit five frameworks: a DCF model (historical free cash flow, WACC, terminal value, intrinsic value against the current price), a valuation methodology set (PE band, PB-ROE, EV-EBITDA, dividend discount, sum of the parts), behavioral finance concepts (overreaction, anchoring, herding, disposition effect) read as momentum or reversal context, a low PE and PB plus high ROE and yield value screen, a small-cap growth screen, and a main business analysis that maps revenue structure, growth attribution and competitive position. Every command is public, no login required. From the longbridge/skills repository (MIT)....
